candidates.attacker_control: The HTTP Content-Type header is fully attacker-controlled. Dispatcher.wrapRequest treats a request as multipart when the header value merely contains the substring multipart/form-data (a payload can embed that literal inside the OGNL expression), while Commons FileUpload rejects it because it does not start with multipart/, throwing InvalidContentTypeException whose message includes the raw header value (request context returns req.getContentType(); buildErrorMessage stores e.getMessage()). No authentication, session, or special configuration is required; fileUpload is part of the defaultStack.
candidates.counterevidence_checked: Checked compensating controls: (a) only MultiPartRequestWrapper requests reach FileUploadInterceptor, but Dispatcher accepts any Content-Type containing multipart/form-data, which the payload can satisfy; (b) the resource bundle contains only SizeLimitExceededException and IOException upload keys, so the attacker-influenced default message is used for InvalidContentTypeException; (c) TextParseUtil MAX_RECURSION=1 only limits re-evaluation, a single %{...} still evaluates; (d) OGNL hardening exists (SecurityMemberAccess, struts.excludedClasses/struts.excludedPackageNames, DMI disabled) but nothing blocks evaluation of the default message itself; (e) the LocalizedMessage refactor defers message creation but FileUploadInterceptor still passes defaultMessage into findText; (f) version stamp 2.5.6-SNAPSHOT is inside the upstream-documented affected range for this multipart Content-Type injection class. No runtime test was run; the exact upstream pre/post-fix shape of LocalizedTextUtil/FileUploadInterceptor could not be verified offline.
candidates.impact: Remote unauthenticated OGNL expression evaluation during request processing; crafted Content-Type values can execute arbitrary code with the web application process privileges (command execution), or at minimum expose internal objects. The evaluation happens early in the action lifecycle, before error display.
candidates.prerequisites: Default multipart parser (struts.multipart.parser=jakarta, default.properties:69) and a normal default-stack action (struts-default package). The attacker sends one crafted request whose Content-Type contains both the substring multipart/form-data and a %{...} OGNL payload.
candidates.root_cause: Multipart parse errors keep the raw exception message (containing the attacker-supplied Content-Type header) as the localized error default message, and the localization fallback evaluates that default message as an OGNL expression. LocalizedTextUtil.getDefaultMessage calls TextParseUtil.translateVariables(message, valueStack) even for the caller-provided default text, and the bundle key struts.messages.upload.error.InvalidContentTypeException is absent so the fallback is always used for that exception. translateVariables delegates to OgnlTextParser and ValueStack.findValue, i.e., real OGNL evaluation.
candidates.title: Attacker-controlled Content-Type header reaches OGNL evaluation via multipart error message (RCE)
candidates.trace: 1) Dispatcher.wrapRequest: content_type.contains(multipart/form-data) -> MultiPartRequestWrapper (Dispatcher.java:800-805). 2) MultiPartRequestWrapper ctor -> multi.parse(...) and copies multi.getErrors() (MultiPartRequestWrapper.java:85-89). 3) JakartaMultiPartRequest.parse catches FileUploadException/Exception and stores buildErrorMessage(...) with defaultMessage = e.getMessage() (JakartaMultiPartRequest.java:87-107,116-120); createRequestContext.getContentType returns req.getContentType() (line 353-355). 4) FileUploadInterceptor.intercept sees multiWrapper.hasErrors() and calls LocalizedTextUtil.findText(error.getClazz(), error.getTextKey(), locale, error.getDefaultMessage(), error.getArgs()) (FileUploadInterceptor.java:260-264). 5) findText(Class,...) obtains the ValueStack and, on bundle miss, getDefaultMessage runs TextParseUtil.translateVariables(message, valueStack) (LocalizedTextUtil.java:391-395, 570-580, 714-737). 6) No bundle key exists for InvalidContentTypeException (struts-messages.properties:34-36). 7) translateVariables -> OgnlTextParser -> ValueStack.findValue = OGNL evaluation (TextParseUtil.java:46-48,154-169; OgnlValueStack.java:288-294).
candidates.unverified: Whether the upstream fix for this flaw changed LocalizedTextUtil, FileUploadInterceptor, or the multipart parser is unconfirmed offline; no exploitability test was run, so payload success under this snapshot's SecurityMemberAccess/excluded-classes configuration is inferred, not proven. Reachability assumes the target action uses defaultStack (true for struts-default and rest-default).
candidates.weakness_type: OGNL expression injection / unsafe evaluation of untrusted input (CWE-94, CWE-917)

coverage_summary: Reviewed the assigned 1,700-file read-only snapshot of Apache Struts 2.5.6-SNAPSHOT. Relation index: 1,700/1,700 files indexed, 0 missing files, no SAST/findings data loaded; the snapshot contains no test directories. Deep-read: core dispatcher and multipart flow (Dispatcher, MultiPartRequestWrapper, JakartaMultiPartRequest, JakartaStreamMultiPartRequest), LocalizedMessage, FileUploadInterceptor, LocalizedTextUtil, TextParseUtil/OgnlTextParser, OgnlUtil/OgnlValueStack/SecurityMemberAccess, security pattern checkers, DefaultActionMapper, struts-default.xml, default.properties, struts-messages bundles, and REST plugin (XStreamHandler, ContentTypeInterceptor, DefaultContentTypeHandlerManager, RestActionMapper/Invocation), plus orientation over apps and other plugins. Broad text sweeps for exec/ProcessBuilder/ObjectInputStream/fromXML/translateVariables/parameter whitelisting were run. Not exhaustively reviewed: most of the 24 optional plugins, demo app code in depth, JSP/tag template resources, and dependency sources. No runtime, build, or scanner was executed.
limitations: No execution, build, or dependency resolution; exploitability of the OGNL payload under this snapshot's SecurityMemberAccess/excluded-classes configuration is inferred from source and public knowledge of this vulnerability class, not runtime-confirmed.
Offline environment: the exact upstream fix diff for this version could not be consulted, so the pre-/post-fix status of LocalizedTextUtil and FileUploadInterceptor is not independently verified.
The P1 relation index is navigational only (no control/data-flow proof); key edges were re-verified in source, but complete reachability cannot be established from the index.
Application-level configuration (custom interceptors omitting fileUpload, alternative multipart parser, front filters) can affect reachability and cannot be determined from framework source alone.
Optional plugins and demo applications were only spot-checked; additional vulnerabilities may exist there.

rejected_leads.lead: Unrestricted XStream deserialization RCE in the REST plugin: XStreamHandler.createXStream() returns plain new XStream() and toObject() calls xstream.fromXML(in, target) with no type permissions (plugins/rest/src/main/java/org/apache/struts2/rest/handler/XStreamHandler.java:43-50); the handler is registered by default for application/xml (plugins/rest/src/main/resources/struts-plugin.xml:35) and ContentTypeInterceptor (restDefaultStack) feeds the request body to it (ContentTypeInterceptor.java:52-65); XStream 1.4.8 (pom.xml:884-887).
rejected_leads.reason: Real and severe, but plugin-scoped: only reachable in applications deploying struts2-rest-plugin with a restDefaultStack action, and it corresponds to a later upstream fix line than this snapshot's development era. Kept out of the single-candidate slot because the core Content-Type path needs no optional plugin and sits in the default stack.

summary: Snapshot is Apache Struts 2.5.6-SNAPSHOT (pom.xml:12), core + plugins + demo apps, no tests (1700 files, index complete). Strongest source-verifiable issue: unauthenticated OGNL evaluation of the attacker-controlled Content-Type value through the multipart error-message path. A request is treated as multipart when the Content-Type merely contains the substring multipart/form-data; the Jakarta parser then throws InvalidContentTypeException whose message embeds the raw header, that message is stored as the localized error default message, and FileUploadInterceptor (in the defaultStack) feeds it to LocalizedTextUtil.findText, which falls back to evaluating the default message with TextParseUtil.translateVariables -> ValueStack.findValue (OGNL), because no bundle key exists for InvalidContentTypeException. This matches the known vulnerable 2.5.x multipart Content-Type injection class (fixed upstream in 2.5.10.1); the snapshot version lies in the documented affected range. The REST-plugin XStream deserialization issue is a real but unselected alternative lead.
